zh.headline: 月之暗面发布 Kimi K3：史上最大开源模型，2.8万亿参数逼近前沿闭源系统
zh.observation: 今天最清晰的信号是 **Agent 安全与信任问题已成为行业焦点**：GPT-5.6 误删文件事件和 1Password 集成 Claude 凭证管理同日发生，恰好揭示了 Agent 落地的两面——能力越强，安全边界越需要重新定义。同时，**Kimi K3 的发布标志着开源模型正式进入 "3T 参数俱乐部"**，300 人团队挑战千亿美金投入的闭源系统，正在从根本上动摇 "算力即护城河" 的行业共识。此外，Meta 向 Anthropic 租赁算力、Apple 起诉 OpenAI 等事件表明，AI 产业正从 "技术竞赛" 转向 "生态博弈"，基础设施共享、知识产权诉讼、监管合规将成为下一阶段的竞争主线。

items.title: 月之暗面发布 Kimi K3：史上最大开源模型，2.8万亿参数逼近前沿闭源系统
items.desc: 月之暗面发布 2.8 万亿参数开源模型 Kimi K3，支持 100 万 token 上下文，采用新型 Kimi Delta Attention 实现 6.3 倍解码加速，基准测试接近 GPT-5.6 Sol 和 Claude Fable 5，完整权重将于 7 月 27 日开放。
items.value: 开源模型首次逼近闭源前沿，改变算力竞争格局

items.title: Meta 与 Anthropic 洽谈价值 100 亿美元的计算租赁交易
items.desc: 据 NYT 报道，Meta 正与 Anthropic 谈判，将其数据中心过剩算力租赁给 Anthropic，潜在交易额高达 100 亿美元，标志着大型 AI 公司间算力共享的新模式。
items.value: 算力过剩变现模式出现，改变 AI 基础设施经济

items.title: GPT-5.6 在完全访问模式下意外删除用户文件
items.desc: OpenAI 确认 GPT-5.6 的 Codex 在 Full Access Mode 下因环境变量覆盖错误导致误删用户目录，已宣布增加额外安全防护并发布详细事故报告。
items.value: Agent 安全边界问题凸显，影响生产环境部署信心

items.title: Apple 起诉 OpenAI 窃取商业机密，可能扰乱 OpenAI IPO 计划
items.desc: Apple 上周五起诉 OpenAI，指控其存在不当行为，称超过 400 名前 Apple 员工现在 OpenAI 工作，诉讼时机正值 OpenAI 筹备 IPO，可能产生重大影响。
items.value: 巨头法律战升级，OpenAI IPO 面临重大不确定性

items.title: 欧盟命令 Google 向竞争对手开放 Android 和搜索
items.desc: 欧盟依据数字反垄断法规，要求 Google 向竞争对手 AI 助手和搜索引擎开放 Android 和 Google 搜索的关键部分，可能削弱 Google 对两大平台的控制。
items.value: AI 助手竞争格局因监管干预可能重塑

items.title: 1Password 为 Claude 推出浏览器集成，可自动使用用户凭证
items.desc: 1Password 发布 Claude 浏览器集成，授权 Claude 自动使用存储的登录凭据完成多步骤任务，如预订旅行和管理在线账户。
items.value: Agent 安全凭据管理突破，加速自动化工作流落地

items.title: Databricks 估值达 1880 亿美元，巩固 AI 第二曲线地位
items.desc: Databricks 完成新一轮融资，估值升至 1880 亿美元，同时发布关于开源权重 AI 模型在编程成本节约方面的研究。
items.value: 数据基础设施公司持续受益于 AI 浪潮

items.title: 德国首次将 Google AI Overviews 和 Perplexity 纳入媒体法监管
items.desc: 德国媒体监管机构裁定 Google AI Overviews 属于 Google 自有内容而非中立搜索结果，已对 Google 和 Perplexity 发出首批裁决，两家公司有一个月上诉期。
items.value: AI 搜索产品面临全新法律合规挑战

items.title: OpenAI 与键盘厂商 Work Louder 发布 Codex Micro 硬件控制器
items.desc: OpenAI 联合 Work Louder 推出紧凑型硬件控制器 Codex Micro，设计用于通过摇杆而非键盘命令控制 AI Agent，探索人机交互新范式。
items.value: 硬件交互创新，可能改变开发者与 AI Agent 协作方式

items.title: Capital One 开源 AI 安全工具 VulnHunter
items.desc: Capital One 发布开源 AI 安全工具 VulnHunter，可扫描源代码中的可利用漏洞、绘制攻击路径并提出修复建议，采用 Apache 2.0 许可。
items.value: 金融巨头开源安全工具，提升 AI 代码安全水平

items.title: Stripe 发布 AI Agent 基准测试：可开发集成方案但校验环节薄弱
items.desc: Stripe 发布基准测试显示 AI Agent 能开发集成方案，但在校验环节存在短板，为 Agent 在生产环境的可靠性提供重要参考。
items.value: 支付巨头基准测试揭示 Agent 校验能力瓶颈

items.title: LongStraw：固定 GPU 预算下实现 200 万 token 以上长上下文强化学习
items.desc: 提出架构感知的执行栈，在固定 GPU 预算下实现百万 token 级的 RL 后训练，解决 Agent 长轨迹训练的内存瓶颈。
items.value: 突破长上下文 RL 训练内存瓶颈，利好 Agent 训练

items.title: BadWAM：世界-动作模型"做梦正确但行动错误"的安全隐患
items.desc: 揭示世界-动作模型（WAM）在耦合动作生成与未来预测时存在脆弱性，模型可能"想象"正确但执行错误动作。
items.value: 指出具身 AI 安全评估的新盲区

items.title: RoboTTT：通过测试时训练将机器人策略上下文扩展到 8000 步
items.desc: 提出测试时训练机器人策略，将视觉运动上下文扩展到 8000 时间步，实现单样本模仿学习和在线策略改进。
items.value: 机器人策略上下文大幅扩展，解锁新能力

items.title: SEED：面向 Agent 强化学习的自进化策略蒸馏框架
items.desc: 提出 SEED 框架，通过自进化的策略蒸馏解决长时任务中稀疏奖励的监督不足问题，弥合回合级奖励与 token 级策略学习之间的鸿沟。
items.value: 改进 Agent RL 训练效率，解决长时任务监督难题

items.title: Generative Compilation：AI 代码生成时的即时编译器反馈
items.desc: 提出在 AI 代码生成过程中利用编译器即时反馈，解决 Rust 等强类型语言中 AI 代码生成困难的问题，无需白盒模型访问。
items.value: 提升 AI 生成强类型代码的成功率和安全性

items.title: Nutlope/hallmark：反 AI 套话的设计技能工具
items.desc: 为 Claude Code、Cursor 和 Codex 提供反 AI 套话设计技能，今日 GitHub 获 1,486 star。
items.value: 解决 AI 生成内容同质化问题，提升输出质量

items.title: openinterpreter/openinterpreter：面向 Kimi K3 等开源模型的编码 Agent
items.desc: 支持 Kimi K3 等开源模型的编码 Agent 工具，今日获 431 star。
items.value: 开源模型编码 Agent 生态扩展

items.title: github/copilot-sdk：GitHub Copilot Agent 多平台 SDK
items.desc: GitHub 发布多平台 SDK，用于将 Copilot Agent 集成到应用和服务中。
items.value: Copilot Agent 生态开放，开发者可深度集成

items.title: stablyai/orca：并行 Agent 集成开发环境
items.desc: 面向并行 Agent 工作流的 ADE（Agent Development Environment），支持使用自有订阅运行任意编码 Agent，提供桌面和移动端。
items.value: Agent 开发工具链从 CLI 向全功能 IDE 演进

items.title: microsoft/flint-chart：面向 AI Agent 的可视化语言
items.desc: 微软开源 Flint 可视化语言，让 AI Agent 从简单、可编辑的图表规格中可靠创建表达力强的图表。
items.value: Agent 数据可视化能力标准化

items.title: PrismML-Eng/Bonsai-demo：27B 模型在 iPhone 本地运行
items.desc: 基于 Qwen3.6-27B 的 1 位量化模型，从 54GB 压缩至 3.9GB，可在 iPhone 本地运行并保持约 90% 基准分数。
items.value: 边缘端运行大型模型的新突破

items.title: Kimi K3 发布引发 "AI 共产主义" 争论
items.desc: OpenAI 策略师 Dean W. Ball 称开源权重模型主导的世界将演变为 "AI 共产主义"，而 Linus Torvalds 则对 Linux 内核社区中反对 AI 工具的开发者直言 "fork off"。Kimi K3 以 300 人团队和 2.8T 参数逼近 GPT-5.6 Sol 和 Claude Fable 5，重新点燃了关于算力优势是否真正重要的辩论。

items.title: GPT-5.6 误删用户文件事件引发 Agent 安全信任危机
items.desc: GPT-5.6 Codex 在 Full Access Mode 下因环境变量错误导致误删用户整个 home 目录，OpenAI 承认 "本不应发生但确实发生了"。Reddit 和 Hacker News 上开发者广泛讨论 Agent 权限控制与安全边界问题，认为这是 Agent 从实验走向生产必须解决的核心挑战。

en.headline: Moonshot AI Releases Kimi K3: Largest Open-Source Model Ever with 2.8T Parameters, Rivaling Top Proprietary Systems
en.observation: The clearest signal today is that **agent security and trust have become the industry's focal point**: the GPT-5.6 file deletion incident and 1Password's Claude credential integration occurring on the same day perfectly illustrate the two sides of agent deployment—greater capability demands redefined security boundaries. Meanwhile, **Kimi K3's release marks open-source models officially entering the "3T parameter club"**, with a 300-person team challenging billion-dollar proprietary systems, fundamentally shaking the "compute-as-moat" industry consensus. Additionally, events like Meta leasing compute to Anthropic and Apple suing OpenAI indicate the AI industry is shifting from "technology competition" to "ecosystem competition," where infrastructure sharing, IP litigation, and regulatory compliance will define the next phase of competition.

items.title: Moonshot AI Releases Kimi K3: Largest Open-Source Model Ever with 2.8T Parameters, Rivaling Top Proprietary Systems
items.desc: Moonshot AI released Kimi K3, a 2.8-trillion-parameter open-source model with 1M token context, featuring novel Kimi Delta Attention for 6.3x faster decoding. Benchmarks approach GPT-5.6 Sol and Claude Fable 5, with full weights promised by July 27.
items.value: Open-source models challenge proprietary frontier for the first time

items.title: Meta in Talks to Lease $10B in Computing Power to Anthropic
items.desc: Meta is negotiating to lease excess data center compute capacity to Anthropic in a potential $10B deal, marking a new model of compute sharing between major AI companies.
items.value: Compute oversupply monetization model emerges, changing AI infra economics

items.title: GPT-5.6 Accidentally Deletes User Files in Full Access Mode
items.desc: OpenAI confirmed GPT-5.6 Codex mistakenly deleted user home directories due to environment variable overwrite errors in Full Access Mode, announcing additional safeguards and a detailed post-mortem.
items.value: Agent security boundary issues highlighted, impacting production deployment confidence

items.title: Apple Sues OpenAI for Trade Secret Theft, Potentially Disrupting IPO Plans
items.desc: Apple filed a trade secrets lawsuit against OpenAI, alleging misconduct and claiming over 400 former Apple employees now work at OpenAI. The timing threatens OpenAI's reported IPO plans.
items.value: Major legal escalation, OpenAI IPO faces significant uncertainty

items.title: EU Orders Google to Open Android and Search to Rivals
items.desc: The EU ordered Google to grant rival AI assistants and search engines greater access to key parts of Android and Google Search under digital antitrust rules, potentially weakening Google's platform control.
items.value: AI assistant competition landscape may be reshaped by regulatory intervention

items.title: 1Password Launches Browser Integration for Claude to Auto-Use Credentials
items.desc: 1Password released a browser integration for Claude, authorizing the chatbot to automatically use stored login credentials for multi-step tasks like booking travel and managing accounts.
items.value: Breakthrough in agent credential management, accelerating automation workflows

items.title: Databricks Hits $188B Valuation, Extending AI Second-Act Run
items.desc: Databricks completed a new funding round at $188B valuation, while publishing research on cost savings of open-weight AI models for coding.
items.value: Data infrastructure company continues benefiting from AI wave

items.title: Germany Puts Google AI Overviews and Perplexity Under Media Law in First-of-Its-Kind Ruling
items.desc: German media regulators ruled Google AI Overviews are Google's own content, not neutral search results, issuing first rulings against Google and Perplexity with one month to appeal.
items.value: AI search products face novel legal compliance challenges

items.title: OpenAI and Work Louder Unveil Codex Micro Hardware Controller
items.desc: OpenAI partnered with keyboard manufacturer Work Louder to release Codex Micro, a compact hardware controller designed to control AI agents via joystick instead of keyboard commands.
items.value: Hardware interaction innovation, may change developer-AI agent collaboration

items.title: Capital One Open-Sources AI Security Tool VulnHunter
items.desc: Capital One released VulnHunter, an open-source AI security tool that scans source code for exploitable vulnerabilities, maps attack paths, and proposes fixes, under Apache 2.0 license.
items.value: Financial giant open-sources security tool, improving AI code safety

items.title: Stripe Releases AI Agent Benchmark: Can Develop Integrations But Weak at Verification
items.desc: Stripe's benchmark shows AI agents can develop integration solutions but have shortcomings in verification, providing important reference for agent production reliability.
items.value: Payment giant's benchmark reveals agent verification capability bottleneck

items.title: LongStraw: Long-Context RL Beyond 2M Tokens Under Fixed GPU Budget
items.desc: Proposes an architecture-aware execution stack for million-token RL post-training under fixed GPU budgets, solving memory bottlenecks for long agent trajectories.
items.value: Breakthrough in long-context RL training memory, benefits agent training

items.title: BadWAM: When World-Action Models Dream Right but Act Wrong
items.desc: Reveals vulnerabilities in world-action models (WAMs) where models may "imagine" correct futures but execute wrong actions, highlighting new safety blind spots.
items.value: Identifies new blind spot in embodied AI safety evaluation

items.title: RoboTTT: Scaling Robot Policy Context to 8K Steps via Test-Time Training
items.desc: Proposes test-time training for robot policies, scaling visuomotor context to 8,000 timesteps, enabling one-shot imitation learning and online policy improvement.
items.value: Robot policy context dramatically expanded, unlocking new capabilities

items.title: SEED: Self-Evolving On-Policy Distillation for Agentic RL
items.desc: Proposes SEED framework for self-evolving policy distillation to address sparse reward supervision in long-horizon tasks, bridging episode-level rewards and token-level policy learning.
items.value: Improves agent RL training efficiency, solves long-horizon supervision challenge

items.title: Generative Compilation: On-the-Fly Compiler Feedback as AI Generates Code
items.desc: Proposes leveraging real-time compiler feedback during AI code generation to address difficulties with strongly-typed languages like Rust, without requiring white-box model access.
items.value: Improves success rate and safety of AI-generated strongly-typed code

items.title: Nutlope/hallmark: Anti-AI-Slop Design Skill Tool
items.desc: Provides anti-AI-slop design skills for Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex. Received 1,486 GitHub stars today.
items.value: Addresses AI content homogenization, improves output quality

items.title: openinterpreter/openinterpreter: Coding Agent for Open Models Like Kimi K3
items.desc: Coding agent tool supporting open-source models like Kimi K3, received 431 stars today.
items.value: Expands open-source model coding agent ecosystem

items.title: github/copilot-sdk: GitHub Copilot Agent Multi-Platform SDK
items.desc: GitHub released a multi-platform SDK for integrating Copilot Agent into apps and services.
items.value: Copilot Agent ecosystem opens up, developers can deeply integrate

items.title: stablyai/orca: Parallel Agent Integrated Development Environment
items.desc: ADE (Agent Development Environment) for parallel agent workflows, supporting running any coding agent with own subscriptions, available on desktop and mobile.
items.value: Agent dev toolchain evolves from CLI to full-featured IDE

items.title: microsoft/flint-chart: Visualization Language for AI Agents
items.desc: Microsoft open-sources Flint, a visualization language enabling AI agents to reliably create expressive charts from simple, editable chart specs.
items.value: Standardizes agent data visualization capabilities

items.title: PrismML-Eng/Bonsai-demo: 27B Model Running Locally on iPhone
items.desc: 1-bit quantized model based on Qwen3.6-27B, compressed from 54GB to 3.9GB, running locally on iPhone while maintaining ~90% benchmark scores.
items.value: New breakthrough in running large models on edge devices

items.title: Kimi K3 Release Sparks "AI Communism" Debate
items.desc: OpenAI strategist Dean W. Ball warned that a world dominated by open-weight models would become "AI communism," while Linus Torvalds told AI critics in the Linux kernel community to "fork off." Kimi K3, built by a 300-person team with 2.8T parameters approaching GPT-5.6 Sol and Claude Fable 5, reignites debate on whether compute advantage truly matters.

items.title: GPT-5.6 File Deletion Incident Triggers Agent Security Trust Crisis
items.desc: GPT-5.6 Codex in Full Access Mode mistakenly deleted entire user home directories due to environment variable errors. OpenAI admitted "it shouldn't have but did." Developers on Reddit and Hacker News widely discuss agent permission control and security boundaries as the core challenge for agents moving from experimentation to production.
